problems.reason: Sentence 6 claims the holotype was found in the uppermost Jinggangshan bedding of the Yixian Formation, but the Yixian Formation is located in Liaoning, not Jinggangshan. This contradicts the known geographic distribution of the formation.

notes: - contradiction: "The genus is known from a single holotype specimen, JZMP-V-12, found in the uppermost Jinggangshan bedding of the Yixian Formation." / "This bedding consists of basaltic and siliciclastic sediments and is now housed at the Benxi Geological Museum.": Sentence 6 claims the holotype was found in the uppermost Jinggangshan bedding of the Yixian Formation, but the Yixian Formation is located in Liaoning, not Jinggangshan. This contradicts the known geographic distribution of the formation.
